entities.name: Wylie Duke
entities.description: A legendary Atiin ranger from an unknown plane, considered a hero among his people; he joined the Freestriders on Thunder Junction.

entities.name: Freestriders
entities.description: Group Wylie joined on Thunder Junction.

entities.name: Thunder Junction
entities.description: Plane Wylie arrived on after the Omenpaths opened.

entities.name: Omenpaths
entities.description: Passages whose opening let Wylie arrive on Thunder Junction.

events.summary: Wylie Duke arrived on Thunder Junction after the opening of the Omenpaths and joined the Freestriders.
events.quote: After arriving on Thunder Junction, he joined the Freestriders .

relations.quote: He is a member of the Atiin
